propositions: CodeQL scan cadence changed from weekly (23 4 * * 1) to 6-hourly (35 */6 * * *) to restore coverage parity with the original push-on-main design
The previous weekly cron was justified by a 28x cost increase that no longer applies because navapbc/rebar is a public repository where GitHub Actions and CodeQL are free
Six-hourly lanes (test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, codeql.yml) must use distinct off-the-hour cron minutes (41, 47, 53, 35 respectively) to avoid scheduler congestion
CodeQL has no push trigger and must remain on schedule-only execution, requiring a separate test cohort distinct from the general six-hourly group
Test coverage in test_ci_main_push_policy.py was retargeted to pin the new cadence, staggering invariant, and no-push behavior rather than deleted
